description: This Java class 'MatrixGrabber' is designed for use with OpenGL ES 1.0 in an Android environment. It captures the current model-view and projection matrices from the OpenGL context, which can be used for tasks like coordinate transformations or debugging.

classes.name: MatrixGrabber
classes.description: A utility class for capturing the current OpenGL model-view and projection matrices.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Stores the current model-view and projection matrices from the OpenGL context.

methods.name: getMatrix
methods.description: Retrieves the specified matrix (model-view or projection) from the OpenGL context.
